facts.fact: 第二人称转生：黑白水塔点亮黑白星空、timpani roll 如存在开幕——「You and here. Deceptively straightforward. Utterly incomprehensible」；曾是人 Wilhelm（名字来处记不得）；事故→怪物→timpani→nothing again（flayed on lab floor 归 void）——「The whole thing took a lifetime. And yet it was over in less than ninety minutes.」；火犹可感（村民烧 Lab、毛发成块如 hot glue）——「It felt so real, until it didn't.」

Wilhelm 生平：Dr. Wilhelm Arnold Stratford、German descent、父母面孔名字无法 conjure；童年 happy 却「lies outside the margins of actual experience——仿佛真正的出生发生在九十分钟前 logo 亮起那一刻」；Marcela 野餐（Harvard Square 外河畔、freckled cheeks、boyish smile、mustard seed 滴上 summer dress）=第一个 real memory——「I'm mortified!」蘸河水的 gallant——obsessions 毁掉一切（想做 great、push limits、change history）；stem cells/interspecies fusion 被大学骂 affront to God；Marcela 父 ultimatum——final night 被催赶 rush 成疯狂
facts.anchor: a truer birth occurred long afterwards.

facts.fact: 记忆分叉：一世界=slip on puddle 放走蝙蝠；另一版=关着的 radio 里传出 voice——「Find a screen. Find a screen, Wilhelm.」——「怎可能？怎会有两份记忆？没有 voice。却有。」——滑倒撞 cage、cadaver 脑细胞融合的 specimen 咬臂——infected、own experiment

怪物与杀戮：镜前 great cry——Chimotera! half-man half-bat、unprecedented strength/appetite/bloodlust——「You were an abomination. Everything was natural.」；Marcela 父讨答复→pounced、devoured（indiscernible from a plate of liver）；mob storm castle；Marcela 执意现身「I could never be frightened of you」——火瓶、现身、她尖叫「You're a monster! You're not Wilhelm!」——扑向新娘想护却不知力气——claws shred her face——河边 flashback——lifeless；THE END——「It should have been as such. That should have been all. So why are you still here?」

复醒：睁眼回到烧毁处、无痛、alive again；Marcela 与村民全 erased；radio 倒地 huffing「Find a screen」——进入 full color/finer resolution/deeper 更 vivid 的世界（连空气都不再 cheap imitation）；村庄 raptured away；Murray's Old General 橱窗 radio 合唱；Grand Paramount（周五 silent pictures 之地）marquee 空白、撕门而入、前排坐等——灯暗——无声默片里一个 man、vest 上 RadioShack logo——title cards 对话：「There you are」「I've been a fan my whole life」「My name is Anthony Fischer, but you can call me Fisch」「And you…you are Wilhelm」——「That's not my name anymore. Not since the accident」——「I need Wilhelm. The man, the scientist. I need his help」——「But I'm dead」——「Final's not all it used to be……a few rungs up the interdimensional ladder——fate can change、life only just beginning」；「Are you the devil?」——「No. I'm Vice President of Product Development at RadioShack.」——诱惑 Marcela（flashback 播八次）「How would you like to marry her?」——「And what is your price?」——「Let's call this one a free sample……答应结束后再来见我——Talkies should be invented by then.」
facts.anchor: Final’s not all it used to be
